officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official page describes Sudan Spatial Portal as a national interactive spatial-information viewer offering WMS and WFS; it links to geoportal.gov.sd. It does not name a cadastre/parcel layer.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Judiciary of the Republic of Sudan, Land Registry Administration
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official Arabic page says land registration is part of the judiciary, describes survey/settlement and the registrar-general with offices across Sudan. This validates the land registry as authority context but not an open spatial feed.
Prior pass describes this as a national digital real-estate registration service with partner/user-specific land lookup; it is not evidence of public anonymous feature access.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.assessment: Linked portal could not be fetched; no WMS/WFS capabilities or bounded parcel response. Prior pass also failed public portal access. Temporary access failure does not prove absence.
